title: How a company works: finance, marketing, operations and human resources

videos.script: In 2025 Varanda's customers paid ninety-eight million reais. {{flows}} Almost all of it went straight back out: to suppliers, to staff, to rent and trucks. Less than three reais in every hundred was left as profit. An analyst who does not know where the money goes cannot tell which number matters. This lesson is that map. Four functions manage the flows, and each one reads the same number differently. {{finance}} First finance. You type Varanda's income statement and compute its margins. Then a sofa sold on ten instalments shows why profit is not cash. {{funnel}} Then marketing. The online funnel goes from visits to carts to orders, and a fall in sales can be traced to the step where people stopped. {{ops}} Then operations: how long stock sits in the warehouse, and how many deliveries arrive on time. {{people}} Last, people. Turnover and absence, and why a table of them is a table of named individuals.
